div.div: No relationship is drawn. The schema declares no foreign key. These 16 tables are in the database monitor, beside the tables of the batch MVP (er, monitor-database). The batch MVP API does not use them, and S4-07 removes their code. live_realized_metrics and live_baselines have no primary key, only a unique key.
